about: The QTc was 486 ms on 20 January during continued citalopram treatment at 40 mg daily.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about QTc during escitalopram 20 mg daily, and the preceding citalopram course at 20 mg daily does not qualify.
Citalopram remained at 20 mg daily when its directions changed, the QTc relevant to oral domperidone was 452 ms, and the later 486 ms result accompanied ciprofloxacin eye drops.
